rca_of_issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/src/App.css .rl-hero-bg uses background-size:cover + background-position:center. The banner image aspect ratio is 1920x720 (~2.67:1 landscape) while iPad portrait is 820x1180 (~0.69:1 portrait). With cover, height is scaled to 1180 → width becomes 1180*(1920/720) ≈ 3146px. With center position, ~1163px is cropped from each side, removing the mala which sits on the left ~0-30% of the source image. Mobile rule @media (max-width:760px) already solves this by stacking, but the range 761-1100px (iPads, small tablets) falls back to the desktop overlay and hides the mala. Fix: either raise the stacking breakpoint to 1100px, or at 761-1100px set background-position:left center and consider background-size:auto 100% plus a defined hero height.
